tool_input.command:
git add internal/email/imap.go internal/testserver/imap.go && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(lint): fix 32-bit build break in G115 overflow clamps (H1, H2)

The MaxUint32 clamps added for gosec G115 compared/assigned an untyped
constant (4294967295) against a plain int, which overflows int on a
32-bit platform (verified with GOOS=linux GOARCH=386 go build). These
are message/UID counts, genuinely int-sized in practice, so clamp
against math.MaxInt32 instead -- it fits a native int on every
platform and needs no widening cast.

Also drops recencySet's `count < 0` branch: both call chains validate
count > 0 before clampCount/recencySet ever see it, so the branch
guarded a documented-impossible precondition. The countU variable
(int, but named as if unsigned) is replaced by width (uint32).
EOF
)"
